definitions.calm_baseline: eval bars with no shock of the same threshold in the previous 60 bars
definitions.recent_shock: a shock in bars t-20 .. t-1
definitions.units: probabilities and shares in percent / percentage points; fz in risk units; f10_simple in percent

S4_left_tail.note: f20 is a LOG return: -0.25 = -22.1% and -0.40 = -33.0% in simple terms; fz20 = f20 / (sig0 * sqrt(20))

S5_breakeven_survivorship.note: Sensitivity bound only. The true delisting rate cannot be observed in survivor-only data.

protocol: Set A is the development set: the script was first run on A alone and every threshold, window and test was fixed there. B, DJ, LH and MS were then run once. The descriptive fields first_k_*, the S4 concentration block and the S6 first-date structure were added after that run; they use no resampling and the fixed seeds reproduce every earlier number exactly. No correction for multiple comparisons is applied: read single intervals with that in mind. S1 is not run on DJ (31 stocks inside LH).
